decisions.reason: The source changes connector orientation on the main board but does not change the sensor board's placement, top-edge alignment, or cable-access requirements.
The source concerns main-board connectors and does not alter any power-board placement, orientation, clearance, or enclosure-fit constraint.
Changing the physical orientation of the main-board connectors does not change their count, destinations, electrical types, or retained individual-connector architecture.
Straight rather than L-shaped connectors do not change the required panel controls, GPIO mappings, wiring, or connector-mediated connection behavior.
Connector mechanical orientation does not affect the LED supply voltage, logic-level handling, model, or separate power control.
The source targets main-board connectors and does not change the power-board battery connector's type, pinout, placement, or orientation.
The source does not identify the ESP32 through-hole breakout or change its full-pin access, technology, or reuse role.
The main-board mechanical orientation change does not alter the sensor board's connector count, families, pin counts, or pinouts.
Replacing L-shaped connectors with straight connectors does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The connector orientation decision does not change the monitor IC, monitored rails, monitor position, or current-coverage semantics.
The source does not change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
Connector mechanical orientation does not affect the I2C series-resistor value, population policy, purpose, or topology.
